title: Disentangling Self-Distillation: Measuring and Modeling Acquisition and Retention
abstract: arXiv:2609.39494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-distillation with privileged context adapts a language model from demonstrations by letting the model, once conditioned on a reference response, teach its context-free copy token by token. Our taxonomy reveals existing methods differ along three entangled axes: (i) the rollout source (student or teacher), (ii) the teacher coupling (frozen, or an exponential moving average of the student at some coupling rate) and (iii) the KL direction (reverse or forward), yet these axes are usually studied in fixed combinations and have led to conflicting conclusions. We formalize a unifying framework to encompass all self-distillation methods vs classic supervised fine-tuning: we train every combination of the three axes, on Qwen2.5-7B and Ministral-3-3B across ordinary and contradictory tasks, totaling 1,200 adaptation runs, to systematically investigate the impact of the above axes. We propose a controlled model of the same objective to explain

translated_title: 解耦自蒸馏：测量与建模知识获取与保持
translated_abstract: 基于特权上下文的自蒸馏通过让模型在以参考回复为条件时，逐token地教导其无上下文的副本，从而从演示数据中适配语言模型。我们的分类学揭示了现有方法在三个相互纠缠的维度上存在差异：(i) rollout来源（学生或教师），(ii) 教师耦合方式（冻结，或以某种耦合率对学生模型进行指数移动平均），以及 (iii) KL散度方向（反向或前向）；然而这些维度通常以固定组合的方式被研究，并导致了相互矛盾的结论。我们形式化了一个统一框架，以涵盖所有自蒸馏方法与经典监督微调的对比：我们在Qwen2.5-7B和Ministral-3-3B模型上，针对普通任务和矛盾任务，训练这三个维度的所有组合，共计1,200次适配运行，以系统地研究上述各维度的影响。我们提出了一个基于相同目标的受控模型来解释
tldr: 该论文首次将自蒸馏方法解耦为rollout来源、教师耦合方式和KL方向三个独立维度，通过1,200次系统实验构建统一框架，解释了以往固定组合研究导致矛盾结论的根源。
en_tdlr: This paper disentangles self-distillation into three independent axes—rollout source, teacher coupling, and KL direction—and systematically evaluates all combinations across 1,200 adaptation runs, unifying prior methods in a single framework to explain previously conflicting conclusions.
